\section[(dialogue)]{Can, want and why — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R98-first-pass-can-want-and-why}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a salad and a kebab.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to be able to, a skill, ability, a right, a chance
  \item a tool, an owner, power, a wish, hope
  \item a plan, a need, a decision, a goal, a request
  \item why?, because, because, a reason, a cause
  \item therefore, a pillow, a blanket, a curtain, a nail
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To be able to? (\textbf{\fa{توانستن}}, \emph{tavânestan}.) A skill? (\textbf{\fa{مهارت}}, \emph{mahârat}.) Ability? (\textbf{\fa{توانایی}}, \emph{tavânâyi}.) A right? (\textbf{\fa{حق}}, \emph{hagh}.) A chance? (\textbf{\fa{فرصت}}, \emph{forsat}.) A tool? (\textbf{\fa{ابزار}}, \emph{abzâr}.) An owner? (\textbf{\fa{صاحب}}, \emph{sâheb}.) Power? (\textbf{\fa{قدرت}}, \emph{ghodrat}.) A wish? (\textbf{\fa{آرزو}}, \emph{ârezu}.) Hope? (\textbf{\fa{امید}}, \emph{omid}.) A plan? (\textbf{\fa{برنامه}}, \emph{barnâme}.) A need? (\textbf{\fa{نیاز}}, \emph{niyâz}.) A decision? (\textbf{\fa{تصمیم}}, \emph{tasmim}.) A goal? (\textbf{\fa{هدف}}, \emph{hadaf}.) A request? (\textbf{\fa{خواهش}}, \emph{khâhesh}.) Why?? (\textbf{\fa{چرا}}, \emph{cherâ}.) Because? (\textbf{\fa{زیرا}}, \emph{zirâ}.) Because? (\textbf{\fa{چون}}, \emph{chon}.) A reason? (\textbf{\fa{دلیل}}, \emph{dalil}.) A cause? (\textbf{\fa{سبب}}, \emph{sabab}.) Therefore? (\textbf{\fa{بنابراین}}, \emph{banâbarin}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\fa{بالش}}, \emph{bâlesh}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\fa{پتو}}, \emph{patu}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\fa{پرده}}, \emph{parde}.) A nail? (\textbf{\fa{میخ}}, \emph{mikh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the house and clothes — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R98-second-pass-things-in-the-house-and-clothes}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a hammer, scissors, a needle, thread, soap
  \item a towel, a cup, a pot, a frying pan, a stove
  \item a fridge, matches, a ball, a kite, a skirt
  \item a shawl, gloves, an earring, a necklace, boots
  \item sandals, a stew, soup, a salad, a kebab
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A hammer? (\textbf{\fa{چکش}}, \emph{chakosh}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\fa{قیچی}}, \emph{gheychi}.) A needle? (\textbf{\fa{سوزن}}, \emph{suzan}.) Thread? (\textbf{\fa{نخ}}, \emph{nakh}.) Soap? (\textbf{\fa{صابون}}, \emph{sâbun}.) A towel? (\textbf{\fa{حوله}}, \emph{hule}.) A cup? (\textbf{\fa{فنجان}}, \emph{fenjân}.) A pot? (\textbf{\fa{دیگ}}, \emph{dig}.) A frying pan? (\textbf{\fa{ماهیتابه}}, \emph{mâhitâbe}.) A stove? (\textbf{\fa{اجاق}}, \emph{ojâgh}.) A fridge? (\textbf{\fa{یخچال}}, \emph{yakhchâl}.) Matches? (\textbf{\fa{کبریت}}, \emph{kebrit}.) A ball? (\textbf{\fa{توپ}}, \emph{tup}.) A kite? (\textbf{\fa{بادبادک}}, \emph{bâdbâdak}.) A skirt? (\textbf{\fa{دامن}}, \emph{dâman}.) A shawl? (\textbf{\fa{شال}}, \emph{shâl}.) Gloves? (\textbf{\fa{دستکش}}, \emph{dastkesh}.) An earring? (\textbf{\fa{گوشواره}}, \emph{gushvâre}.) A necklace? (\textbf{\fa{گردنبند}}, \emph{gardanband}.) Boots? (\textbf{\fa{چکمه}}, \emph{chakme}.) Sandals? (\textbf{\fa{صندل}}, \emph{sandal}.) A stew? (\textbf{\fa{خورش}}, \emph{khoresh}.) Soup? (\textbf{\fa{سوپ}}, \emph{sup}.) A salad? (\textbf{\fa{سالاد}}, \emph{sâlâd}.) A kebab? (\textbf{\fa{کباب}}, \emph{kabâb}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
